One continuous locked-camera shot, premium cinematic 3D animation. Animate the supplied scene <Picture 1> without changing composition, camera angle, scale, background geometry or sunlight. Alice is the petite toddler at screen left, round rosy face, large brown eyes, dark bob with bangs and one pink bow, pink pajamas with one white chest heart and pink socks. Mother is the adult woman at screen right, warm peach skin, brown eyes, shoulder-length wavy chestnut hair, teal shirt and cream trousers. The distant adult Dutch milkmaid has a blonde braid, white cap, blue dress with white blouse/apron and dark boots; she remains seated at her milking stool behind the wooden fence. Two black-white dairy cows remain in their same separate background positions behind the fence. Preserve every identity, proportion, hairstyle, costume and prop from Picture 1.
ACTION: Mother asks Alice warmly about the taste of milk, looking at her with one small nod. Her hand rests by the three round wooden tokens already on the table. Alice listens with lips closed. Tokens and bottle remain stationary. No one enters the frame.
Only Mother speaks the exact supplied <Audio 1>, matching its timing and mouth movements: "How does the milk taste when you take a sip, sweetie?" Alice and the milkmaid keep lips gently closed throughout. Background motions are tiny natural blinks and breathing only, with no walking, enlargement, duplication, pail movement or fence crossing. No new objects, cuts, camera movement, words or graphics. The start and ending guide preserve the same staging; use restrained acting between them.
